cohort: Women who gave birth in Hamad Medical Corporation (HMC) hospitals between 2019 and 2022.
finding: Of the women eligible for screening, 84.2% were screened by the DIP program in Qatar, and the prevalence of DIP was 36.9%.
mod_finding: Women with GDM had a lower risk of IUFD and SGA but a higher risk of C-section and large for gestational age (LGA) compared to women without GDM.
